reviewNote: Declared facts about what constitutes Sector Intelligence today, from a read-only audit of Sector_Engine (deployed/sector-engine-00072-way), iOS Michael-Master (afc0095e) and Android Michael-Master (7b10cb3). Runtime facts (serving revision, upstream brain status, freshness, per-lake inputs) are read live by the publisher and are never declared here.

implementations.coverage: On demand at any coordinate; every directory lake resolves
implementations.method: GET /conditions: 10 factors scored 0-100, regime weights (normal / spawn / tailwater), gate caps, seeability ceiling; returns score, band, confidence, factors[], gates[], topReasons[], whereToLook[], tonight, nights[]
implementations.runsIn: sector-engine Cloud Run service, per request (short response cache)
implementations.versioning: No score/engine version constant. Tuning is overridable through Firebase Remote Config without a version in the response. Only waterTempState.modelVersion and clarityVisibility.model carry versions.

implementations.coverage: Guntersville only (Wheeler dry run shows nothing)
implementations.method: On-device: biological state per species, attraction percentile per shoreline segment, huntability 0-100, recommendation class via a decision table (no blended score), priority zones, answer-field map layer
implementations.runsIn: iOS app on the phone; inputs from Engine /conditions plus bundled Guntersville data
implementations.note: Merged to iOS Michael-Master (PR #213, 2026-09-28) after the last tagged release v4.1.0-28; it has no account or flag gate, so the next iOS build cut from Michael-Master would show it to every user. Android has no FishIntel.

implementations.method: Species policy gate that withholds species without a ratified policy; Engine part removes gated species from spawn-regime selection
implementations.note: The Engine part changes production spawn scoring, so deploying it is a customer-behaviour change that needs separate approval.

implementations.method: Pilot: consumes normalized Brain states (lake, water temp, clarity, wind, biological) and publishes a per-lake evaluation for the pilot lakes with drivers, limiting factors, degraded inputs and input versions; no rating, score or recommendation
implementations.note: Pilot (2026-10-12): normalized inputs and an evaluation for the 5 pilot lakes from real specialist Brain states, with provenance. No fishing judgment, no customer score; the customer path is engine-conditions-score.

lake-brain.customerPathToday: /conditions reads water level and dam generation itself (USGS nearest gauge, TVA/CWMS/SWPA/Alabama Power) and resolves the lake from the embedded directory; no Lake Brain is read.

water-temp.customerPathToday: /conditions resolves water temperature in-process (WaterTemperatureResolver). The Water Temp Brain republishes the same resolver's output, but nothing reads it back from the Brain.

water-clarity.customerPathToday: /conditions computes clarityVisibility in-process (secchi-power-v1 gauge path, else rain-decay-v0). The Water Clarity Brain restates that output; the dependency runs Engine -> Brain, not Brain -> Intelligence.

wind.customerPathToday: /conditions fetches Open-Meteo wind and gusts itself (WindFactor, gates, seeability). The Wind Brain's NBM candidate is a separate shadow and is not read.

biological-state.customerPathToday: /conditions uses its own species table (SpeciesDatabase.swift) for spawn scoring; iOS FishIntel uses its own SpeciesStateModels / SpeciesKnowledgeBase / WaterbodySpecies. Neither reads the Biological Brain.

declaredBlockers.title: No normalized Sector Intelligence evaluation exists for any lake
No Intelligence implementation reads any Brain; every upstream signal is fetched or computed inside /conditions
The customer Conditions Score has software tests but no predictive validation
The Conditions Score has no version constant and Remote Config can change tuning without a version
iOS FishIntel is merged to Michael-Master with no gate and is in no release
Phase 5A guardrails are unmerged; the Engine part changes spawn scoring
Per-lake Biological State is not started; only species knowledge is published

validation.statusNote: Software is tested; Intelligence predictions are not validated. No calibration against logged trips or field observations exists for the Conditions Score, iOS FishIntel or a normalized evaluation.

softwareTests.covers: Conditions factors, aggregator, gates, config overrides, clarity state, water temperature, lake directory, hydrology graph
Attraction, biological state, huntability, Sector Intelligence decision table, priority zones, learning privacy/sync, evaluation harness on synthetic data
Conservation gate, species targeting policy, spawn-signal guard

predictiveValidation.note: No holdout, calibration or field-outcome validation of any Intelligence output.

inputContract.envelope: IntelligenceInput { lakeId, lakeState, waterTemperatureState, waterClarityState, windState, biologicalKnowledge, biologicalState, policyContext, generatedAt, sourceVersions{brainId: version}, freshness{brainId: {generatedAt, stale}}, degradedInputs[] }
inputContract.rule: Intelligence reads each Brain's published state (value, trend, authority, freshness, version) and never re-derives it.

outputContract.note: For the pilot lakes the evaluation (intelligence-eval-v1) is written to /lakes/{k}/states/intelligence and the snapshot field sectorIntelligence with drivers (each naming its slot), limiting factors, degraded inputs, the inputs used and provenance; other lakes carry input availability only. The Conditions Score's semantics are preserved; no new score is invented for the portal.

knownLimitations: This brain publishes metadata, dependency status and per-lake input availability; for the pilot lakes it also publishes a normalized evaluation that restates specialist states (no rating, score or recommendation, not consumed by any customer).
Implementation facts are declared in catalog.json and reviewed by hand; runtime facts are read live.
